name: Ideogram
summary: Ideogram is an AI art tool focused on generating images with text and typography. It enables users to create visually engaging posters, social media content, and graphics by combining AI-powered art generation with customizable fonts and layouts. Ideogram excels at producing images that integrate readable and stylized text.
description: Ideogram is an AI art tool focused on generating images with text and typography. It enables users to create visually engaging posters, social media content, and graphics by combining AI-powered art generation with customizable fonts and layouts. Ideogram excels at producing images that integrate readable and stylized text. Text Integration: Generate images with embedded, stylized text. Typography Controls: Customize fonts, size, and placement. Prompt-Based Art: Create unique visuals from descriptions. Templates: Pre-made layouts for posters and graphics.
